candidate.estimator: contact-evidence-4 — calibrated, target-gated, reliability-weighted temporal kernel-density fusion
design: per-signal reliability + temporal uncertainty priors (offsets currently 0: dev lead/lag signs are inconsistent; uncertainty lives in kernel widths; compact families widen the wrist kernel)
ALL local maxima per motion family contribute kernels (linear value shares), not just the global peak
kernel density over time; estimate = argmax; contactDistribution + modes exposed in the result for calibration

flat 250ms veto REPLACED by: insufficient-mass abstention, multi-modal abstention (comparable peaks >300ms apart, both modes reported), motion-peak-divergence abstention (>700ms from the scanned movement's peak), and ball-contradiction abstention (ball OBSERVED beyond proximity limits at the fused moment)

target gating of ball evidence: turns/proximity discounted or rejected by torso-normalized distance to target paddle (0.55 full / 1.2 reject) or target wrists (0.9 / 1.8); decisions recorded in signal detail strings
ball-flight gate (ball evidence at drift speed is jitter), motion-support time gate (ball evidence with a quiet target is not target contact), ball family mass cap (turn+proximity are one modality)
cross-modal corroboration: paddle and wrist are rigidly coupled — a speed peak with the other modality measured-quiet is discounted (median-relative, interpolated)
physical plausibility ceiling: motion peaks >25 torso/s are tracking glitches and are rejected (rally2's 47 torso/s wrist landmark jump)
late-mode tiebreak for comparable near modes (paddle whip precedes contact; dev-measured)

new optional inputs (backward compatible): targetWrists, strokeFamily, includeFusionKernels; ContactEstimate keeps every v3 field and only ADDS (contactDistribution, modes, fusionKernels; abstained branch gains optional limitingFactors/modes/contactDistribution)
candidate.callSiteWiring: analyzeVideo.ts contact region passes target wrist positions + declared-stroke family to both estimateContact call sites; per-event confirmation now requires ballConfirmed when a measured ball track exists (paddle-only confirmation cannot anchor event selection against an observed non-corroborating ball)
